t2m.label: Average temperature
t2m.data: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 reanalysis), ~50 km grid, averaged over the state
t2m.definition: The air temperature 2 m above the ground, averaged over every hour of the month and every grid square in the state.
t2m.caveat: A state average blends cities, farms, mountains and coasts; one town can warm faster or slower.

t2m_max.label: Hottest day of the month
t2m_max.data: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 reanalysis), ~50 km grid, averaged over the state
t2m_max.definition: The highest daily temperature reached in the month, as a state average of each grid square's hottest day.
t2m_max.caveat: A ~50 km grid square runs cooler than a hot parking lot or city street on the same day.

precip.label: Rain and snow
precip.data: NASA POWER (MERRA-2, bias-corrected with gauges and satellites), ~50 km grid, averaged over the state
precip.definition: All rain and melted snow that fell in the month, in millimetres of water.
precip.caveat: Storms are patchy; a state average smooths out the worst local downpours.

gwetroot.label: Soil wetness (root zone)
gwetroot.data: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 land model), ~50 km grid, averaged over the state
gwetroot.definition: How full of water the soil is where plant roots grow (top ~1 m): 0 is bone dry, 1 is soaked.
gwetroot.caveat: Modelled from weather, not measured in the ground; irrigation is not included.

frost_days.label: Frost days
frost_days.data: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 reanalysis), ~50 km grid, averaged over the state
frost_days.definition: Days when the air near the ground dropped below 0 °C, averaged over the state's grid squares.
frost_days.caveat: Valleys and open fields frost more often than the grid square average.
